description.narrative: (Uganda): With FY 2022 funds, SCENE will deepen engagement, debate, and consensus on constitutional, political, and legal reforms. SCENE will engage citizens to increase trust of, and constructive engagement with, the public sector agencies charged with legislation and the implementation of constitutional and electoral reforms. .SCENE will directly engage key Government of Uganda (GOU) actors, including Parliament, the Electoral Commission, and local law enforcement, to reduce political fragility in a country that has never seen a peaceful transition of power. SCENE will bring together electoral civil society organizations to conduct joint strategic planning, and engage and partner with GOU counterparts to support freer, more peaceful political engagement in Uganda..
